title: Prompt & Quantization Labnote — 2026-03-28
content:
Context:
- Quick scratchlog for small experiments I'm running on reduced-precision variants of the 13B family for the reranker pipeline. Goal: see which quant config gives best latency vs quality tradeoff at short contexts (<=256 tokens) with heavy KV reuse.

High-level summary so far:
- q4_0 with per-channel-fp fallback looks strong on throughput but noisy on rerank accuracy for edge prompts.
- q8_0-v2 gives better consistency but increases memory footprint and slightly slower per-token latency on A100 80GB.
- KV cache hits are where we win; need to re-run with longer prefix reuse to quantify delta.

Notes on environment and baseline:
- model: open13b-v1 (base fp16 baseline), tokenizer: hf tokenizer v0.15 patched (strip trailing spaces for rerank).
- infra: local dev rig - 1x A100-40GB, CUDA 12.3, triton kernels from rlib/kernels@main (branch: perf-wip).
- baseline runs: fp16 greedy, temp=0, top_p=1, batch=8, seq=128, measured 18.2ms/token end-to-end (observed with test harness).

Experiment runs (brief):
- run A: q4_0, grouped quant, per-channel scales, no fused attention kernel, seq=128, batch=8 -> 12.6ms/token, rerank accuracy -1.8 points (vs fp16) on devset1.
- run B: q8_0-v2, per-tensor, fused attn enabled -> 15.9ms/token, rerank accuracy -0.6 pts.
- run C: q4_0 + extra outlier compensation (1-bit overflow correction) -> 13.1ms/token, rerank -1.2 pts but much lower variance in repeated seeds.
- run D: int4 hybrid (kv cached in fp16) -> 11.9ms/token but regression -3.7 pts; noisy outputs on adversarial prompts.

Prompts / eval probes used (short list):
- probe-ambiguity-01: short user utterance with num disambiguation needed (helpful to stress softmax calibration).
- probe-coreference-02: two-turn antecedent test, checks KV reuse effect.
- probe-rerank-edge-03: 6 candidate completion ranking, sensitivity to small score shifts.

Observations on prompts:
- q4 variants sometimes flip ordering on top-2 candidates for probe-rerank-edge-03; suggests small logit shifts near threshold.
- lowering temperature doesn't fix ordering flips (since reranker uses log-prob delta), implies quant noise on logits not sampling randomness.

KV cache experiments notes:
- current implementation stores KV in quantized format for q4_0 -> smaller memory but adds reprojection step during decode which costs ~0.8ms/token.
- hybrid approach (store KV in fp16 even if weights are quantized) reduces decode cost but memory increases ~1.5x. Good tradeoff for long-lived sessions.
- TODO: add a toggle in harness to switch storage format easily and automated sweep for prefix reuse 0/8/32/128.

Qual metrics and quick numbers (devset1, aggregated):
- fp16 baseline: MRR 0.812, top1 acc 0.683, latency 18.2ms/token.
- q4_0 (current): MRR 0.796, top1 0.667, latency 12.6ms/token.
- q8_0-v2: MRR 0.806, top1 0.678, latency 15.9ms/token.
- notes: variability +/-0.002 MRR across seeds for q8_0, +/-0.008 for q4_0.

Calibration attempt (quick):
- idea: post-quant logit scaling per-head to align softmax entropy distributions to fp16 baseline for short contexts.
- implemented naive per-head bias correction from a heldout calibration set (2k examples). Small boost: q4_0 MRR +0.006 but adds another calibration store per model.
- question: cost of storing per-head scale vs benefit; maybe store coarse per-layer scalar instead of per-head.

Open questions / puzzles:
- why does q4_0 variance spike on certain candidate sets? Hypothesis: a few outlier weight rows cause instability when grouped into same bucket. Need to log per-row quant error distribution for offending layers.
- are attention softmax exp saturations causing numerical instability for low-precision weights? Need to try fp16 exp accumulation for softmax only.
- edge-case: tokenization differences cause scoring mismatch between baseline and quant runs for these probes; ensure normalizer applied consistently.

Immediate TODOs (next 48h):
- [ ] Add KV storage toggle to harness and re-run prefix reuse sweep (owner: Amaya)
- [ ] Implement coarse per-layer calibration scalar and test (owner: Amaya)
- [ ] Create small script to dump per-row quant error for top 3 layers by norm (owner: Noah)
- [ ] Add rerank candidate-level debug dumps for runs that flip order (owner: Evelyn)
- [ ] File a ticket to prod-team to discuss making q8_0-v2 default for Dedicated tier for rerank workloads (ticket RL-1580)

Quick procedural notes for reproducibility:
- config file: rlib/experiments/amaya/quant-rerank-2026-03-28.yaml (branch: perf-wip).
- seed sweep: seeds [42, 217, 999]; use deterministic tokenization hook from tools/tokenizer-fix.
- metric logging: use metrics/rerank/mdr-helper; push artifacts to s3://redwood-ci/amaya/quant-rerank/2026-03-28/

Random scratch ideas to try later (parking lot):
- structured quantization: split weight matrix by attention head groups and quantize separately. Might reduce per-row outliers.
- run small gradient-aware emulation where we compute score sensitivity via TinyGrad to find rows with highest influence on logits (cheap proxy).
- look into mixed decoding: keep final LM head in fp16 while rest quantized.

Notes to self before leaving:
- re-run quick A/B for q4_0 + calibration vs q8_0-v2 on long-prefix (256) and capture full candidate distributions.
- put a short blurb in #aml-experiments channel with top-line latency/quality numbers and ask for edge-case examples.

End of labnote.

-- Amaya
